table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,
	ward=max(patient.ward),
	patientname=max(patient.name),
	regno=max(patient.regno),
	department=(select name from accounts where acccode=max(patient.custcode)),
	/*ref1= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno),
	ref2= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno2),
	ref3= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno3),
	ref4= max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno4),*/
	remarks=max(dbo.saleledger.remarks),
	doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name,     
	itemsalestax = Round(Sum (Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
					+ Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2)
					,0),
	saleamount=Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice)
				- Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
				- Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100)
				- saleledger.flatdisc + saleledger.misccharges,0),
			
	totalamount=Isnull(Round(SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				Round( (sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
				Round( sum( (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges  + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	invtype='SALE'
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.patient ON (dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode),
	dbo.saledetail,   
	dbo.accounts
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = :ai_custcode) and
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode
Union all
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,
	ward=max(patient.ward),
	patientname=max(patient.name),
	regno=max(patient.regno),
	department=(select name from accounts where acccode=max(patient.custcode)),
	remarks=max(dbo.saleledger.remarks),
	doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name,     
	itemsalestax = Round(Sum (Round (sd.looseqty * sd.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * sd.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
					+ Round( (sum( (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2)
					,0),
	saleamount=Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice)
				- Round(Sum (Round(( sd.looseqty  * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01)) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
				- Sum (Round( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice  - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100)
				- saleledger.flatdisc + saleledger.misccharges,0),
			
	totalamount=Isnull(Round(SUM(sd.looseqty * sd.unitsalestax) + 
				SUM(ROUND( (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * sd.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
				Round( (sum( (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
					(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) - saleledger.flatdisc) * (saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
				Round( sum( (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
						(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * saleledger.discperc)) + saleledger.misccharges  + saleledger.salestax - saleledger.flatdisc, 0), 0),
	invtype='SALE'
	
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.patient ON (dbo.saleledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode), 
	dbo.saleinvdetail sd,   
	dbo.accounts	
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode ) and 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = :ai_custcode) and
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
	dbo.accounts.name,
	dbo.saleledger.patientcode
Union all
SELECT 
	invcode     = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,    
	date        = dbo.srledger.date,    
	ward=max(patient.ward),
	patientname=max(patient.name),
	regno=max(patient.regno),
	department=(select name from accounts where acccode=max(patient.custcode)), 
	/*	ref1= max(dbo.srledger.custrefno),
	ref2= max(dbo.srledger.custrefno2),
	ref3= max(dbo.srledger.custrefno3),
	ref4= max(dbo.srledger.custrefno4),*/
	remarks=max(dbo.srledger.remarks),
	doctype = Case dbo.srledger.srcatcode When 6 Then 'Cash' When 7 Then 'Credit' Else 'Retail' End, 
	dbo.accounts.name, 
	itemsalestax = - 1 * (Round (Sum (Round (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
							 +  Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
							(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * (srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) 
							,0)),
	
	
	sramount= - 1 * (Round(Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice), 2)
			  - Round(Sum (Round( dbo.srdetail.looseqty  * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01),2)), 2)
			  - Round(Sum (Round( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty  ) * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100), 2) 
			  - srledger.flatdisc + srledger.misccharges,0)),
	
	totalamount=  - 1 * (Isnull(Round(SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
					SUM(ROUND( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
					 Round( (sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) - srledger.flatdisc) * (srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
					Round( sum( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
					(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * srledger.discperc)) + srledger.misccharges + srledger.salestax - srledger.flatdisc, 0), 0)),
	invtype='SALE RETURN'
			
FROM 
	dbo.srledger LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.patient ON (dbo.srledger.patientcode = dbo.patient.patientcode), 
	dbo.srdetail,   
	dbo.accounts	
WHERE 
	( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) and  
	( dbo.srledger.custcode = :ai_custcode )and 
	( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
	( dbo.srledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
	
GROUP BY 
	dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.srledger.date,   
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
	dbo.srledger.discperc,  
	dbo.srledger.salestax, 
	dbo.srledger.srcatcode, 
	dbo.srledger.invgstperc1, 
	dbo.accounts.name   ,
	dbo.srledger.patientcode
	
ORDER BY 
	invtype,
	invcode

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: 'Less Withholding Tax' + '   ' + string(ai_withholdingtax ) + '% ' + '( ' + string( Round( sum( saleamount * (1 -  ai_discperc * 0.01) for all ) *  0.01 * ai_withholdingtax, 2)) + ' ) = '

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: 'Less Disc. of' + '   ' + string(ai_discperc ) + '% ' + '( ' + string( Round( sum( saleamount *   ai_discperc * 0.01for all),2)) + ' ) = '

objects.name: compute_17
objects.expression: sum(saleamount * (1 - 0.01 * ai_discperc) -  (saleamount * (1 - 0.01 * ai_discperc) * 0.01 *ai_withholdingtax ) + itemsalestax for all)
